body:
ItemFormViewModel.pickSuggestion() calls itemsRepo.setStatus(item.id, TODO)
immediately when the suggestion is tapped — before the user confirms the
dialog. Tapping a suggestion and then Cancel still puts the item on the list
(and marks the row dirty -> syncs to every member). Web's equivalent only
applies changes on Save.

Fix: make pickSuggestion purely prefill form state (remember itemId), and move
the setStatus(TODO) into save() alongside the other field writes (status is
currently skipped in add mode precisely because pick already did it — invert
that). Update ItemFormViewModelTest/AddItemDialogTest accordingly.
title: Android: picking an add-dialog suggestion mutates the item before Save/Cancel
